title: General Motors, LLC: GM/AIR BAG INFLATOR MODULE (38 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER, SPORT UTILITY VEHICLES AND MINIVANS. summary: Condensation inside these air conditioning units can splash onto the control board, causing it to short circuit and start a fire. Units: About 460.

summary: These cylinders could be overfilled, which can cause them to release flammable propane gas unexpectedly, posing a risk of fires and explosions. Units: About 1,600.

summary: Bracket hooks that are used to position the height of the mattress can break, causing the mattress to collapse. Babies can become trapped and suffocate when this happens. Units: More than 68,600.

summary: The ceramic handle that extends over the top of the basket can become hot during use, posing a burn hazard, if touched. Units: About 31,000.

title: CPSC, Controlled Energy Corporation Announce Recall of Water Heaters
summary: The heaters can produce dangerous levels of carbon monoxide in the exhaust gas, which can cause serious injuries and death. Units: About 320.

title: CPSC, Pebco Inc. Announce Recall of Hairdryers
summary: These hairdryers have undersized wiring, are not equipped with ground fault circuit interrupters to cut off electrical current in case of contact with water, and have loose electrical connections. The hairdryers pose an electrocution and fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 22,500.

title: Children's Brooms Recalled by EMSCO Inc.
summary: The paint on the handles of these brooms contain high lead levels. CPSC standards ban toys and other children's products containing high levels of lead. Young children could ingest lead from the broom handles, presenting a lead poisoning hazard. Units: About 2,200.

title: CPSC, Dura Kleen (USA) Inc. Announce Recall of Nightlights
summary: The nightlights' electrical connections are loose. They are made from flammable plastic and the power switch does not work. The nightlights pose shock and fire hazards to consumers. Units: About 459,000.

title: Educational Games Recalled by Lakeshore Learning Materials
summary: Metal weights found in the games contain lead, which presents a lead poisoning hazard to children. Lead poisoning in children is associated with behavioral problems, learning disabilities, hearing problems and growth retardation. Units: 13,000.

title: Recent Death Prompts Search for Recalled Play Yards/Cribs
summary: These cribs/play yards can collapse and entrap an infant. Units: About 100,000.

title: Richfood Bleach Recalled by SuperValu Eastern Region
summary: The bottles were mislabeled. The clear plastic 32 oz. bottles were labeled bleach, but contained ammonia. If the ammonia is mixed with bleach or acid, irritating or toxic gasses could be produced. Units: About 500.

title: Toy Drums Recalled by Eden LLC
summary: The mallet sold with the toy drum has spheres on each end that can pose a choking hazard if they become lodged in a young child's throat. Units: About 5,800.

title: New law: Recognizing the 90th birthday of Ronald Reagan. (Public Law 107-1)
summary: H.J.Res. 7 of the 107th Congress became Public Law 107-1 on 2001-02-15.
